SPECIAL ABILITIES: Level 5 Death (su) [phase i] Once every 1d2+1 rounds, the Skull Dragon can call forth a great wraith who scythes at all enemies within a 30 ft. radius of him. All creatures with a total HD that is a multiple of 5 must make a Fortitude save (DC 33) or die. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 27).

Undying (ex) [phase i] Unlike most creature's whose hps drop below zero tend to die, the Skull Dragon regains all of his health back upon death however loses 10% of his max MP (64) each time he is brought down. The Skull Dragon won't die until he is below zero Mp instead and it takes a full-round action for him to return back to life. Skull Dragon gains double the MP and is considered Undead even though he isn't an Undead type but doesn't suffer the lost to Constitution score that most Undead creatures do.

Will o' the Wisp (su) [phase i] Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, Skull Dragon sprinkles little fireflies around one target within a 90-ft. range. The target must make a Reflex save (DC 33) or takes 18d6 points of fire damage.

Deathly Presence (su) [Begins Phase II] Once below 50% mp (323), This Burst Mode lets Skull Dragon appears more menacing and frightful. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Skull Dragon bypass the restriction on frightful presence & Maddening Cacophony, all melee attacks gain 1d8 points of shadow damage, all his spells have a +2 spell DC and cost 1 MP . This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

Disaster (su) [Phase II] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Skull Dragon sites ancient text and symbols that effect all those within a 30-ft.-radius from him. All creatures caught in the area of effect are affected by the following status effects for 1d6 rounds each: Blind (Fort save DC 33), Confuse (Will save DC 33), Doom (Fort save DC 33), Float, Frog (Fort save DC 33), and Silence (Fort save DC 33) to negate them.

Maddening Cacophony (su) [Phase II] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard, the Skull Dragon speaks a disturbing cacophony of sounds and words that sane life was not meant to hear. All creatures in a 60-ft.-radius must make a Will save (DC 33), or be confused for 1d6 rounds and take 1d6 points of Wisdom damage. A creature that saves cannot be affected by spell for 24 hours. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
